name: transcend-rails-agent-controls
description: Connect Claude to Transcend Rails Agent Controls for policy-enforced MCP tool access via browser sign-in.

GATEWAY_BASE_URL.title: Gateway base URL
GATEWAY_BASE_URL.description: HTTPS base URL of your organization's Agent Governance MCP gateway (scheme + host only; no path). Defaults to https://mcp.us.withrails.ai (US). For EU use https://mcp.eu.withrails.ai. Do not append /mcp/... — the plugin adds that.
